knowledge.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
knowledge.relevance: Builds graph-based indexes for questions across document collections, including community-level summaries.
knowledge.difference: A retrieval and generation framework to operate and configure. Knowledge provides a local graph CLI with source passages, changing relations and deterministic inspection routes.

knowledge.title: LightRAG
knowledge.relevance: Combines graph structures and vector retrieval for questions about connected documents.
knowledge.difference: Its indexing and retrieval framework is a useful comparison for model-backed search. Knowledge also exposes a model-free graph workflow; no LightRAG integration or comparative performance result is claimed.

knowledge.title: Graphiti and its MCP server
knowledge.relevance: Maintains temporal graphs as new episodes arrive and offers an MCP interface for AI assistants.
knowledge.difference: Graphiti uses a separately configured graph backend and model routes. Knowledge's local SQLite graph and deterministic commands serve a smaller operational contract.

knowledge.title: Obsidian Skills
knowledge.relevance: Agent skills for Obsidian Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas and CLI operations.
knowledge.difference: Useful when editing a vault or Canvas after a Knowledge export. These skills work with note formats; they do not establish the truth of graph relations. They are not bundled or installed here.

knowledge.title: Notion Research & Documentation skill
knowledge.relevance: A published skill for finding Notion sources and synthesizing cited briefs, comparisons and reports.
knowledge.difference: It depends on Notion access and document workflows. Knowledge instead exposes a local graph of claims and sources. This is a pinned reference to the method, not an installed connector or copied skill.

knowledge.title: Microsoft Azure AI Search Python skill
knowledge.relevance: SDK guidance for full-text, vector and hybrid search, indexing and enrichment.
knowledge.difference: Relevant when a project needs a managed cloud retrieval index. It requires separately configured Azure services and authentication; Knowledge's local graph does not require that service. No integration is supplied.

knowledge.title: Docling
knowledge.relevance: Parses documents into structured representations suitable for downstream text and AI workflows.
knowledge.difference: Document conversion can prepare input for a graph. Knowledge's source and relation inspection happens later; Docling is not an included dependency or a verified ingestion adapter.

knowledge.title: Microsoft MarkItDown
knowledge.relevance: Converts supported file formats to Markdown for text analysis and language-model workflows.
knowledge.difference: It addresses conversion rather than temporal graph storage or claim evidence. A separately reviewed conversion step could supply readable input; no adapter or automatic integration is claimed.

knowledge.title: Zotero
knowledge.relevance: Collects, organizes, annotates and cites research sources, with optional synchronization and shared libraries.
knowledge.difference: Zotero manages publications and bibliographies. Knowledge follows claims and relationships through supplied material. A citation manager and a claim graph solve different parts of the research workflow; no connector is bundled.

knowledge.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
knowledge.relevance: Research on graph indexes and community summaries for questions about an entire document collection.
knowledge.difference: Useful background for retrieval design. The paper's experiments concern its own systems and datasets; they do not benchmark or validate Knowledge.

knowledge.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
knowledge.relevance: Studies graph and vector retrieval, including retrieval at different levels and incremental updates.
knowledge.difference: A research comparison for indexing and retrieval choices. Its reported results are not results for Knowledge, and listing it does not mean its implementation is reused.

knowledge.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
knowledge.relevance: Separates extraction, reasoning across sessions, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates and abstention in memory evaluation.
knowledge.difference: These distinctions can inform future tests of changing knowledge. Knowledge has not been evaluated on LongMemEval; this is a benchmark reference, not a passed evaluation.

knowledge.title: W3C PROV Overview
knowledge.relevance: A standards overview for describing where data came from through entities, activities and agents.
knowledge.difference: Background for thinking about provenance and interchange. Knowledge's source fields do not by themselves establish PROV serialization support or standards conformance.

knowledge.title: Google Gemini Notebook
knowledge.pricing_model: Free access and higher-capacity paid Google plans; eligibility varies.
knowledge.relevance: A hosted notebook for working with selected sources and generating source-grounded research outputs.
knowledge.difference: A managed research interface rather than a local SQLite graph and CLI. Review account terms and data handling before uploading material; this list does not configure or connect the service.

knowledge.title: Readwise Reader
knowledge.pricing_model: Subscription with a trial; current plans are listed by Readwise.
knowledge.relevance: Collects reading material and supports highlighting, annotation, search and note exports.
knowledge.difference: It organizes the reading and capture stage. Knowledge can inspect relationships in material supplied to it, but no Readwise connector, highlight sync or paid account is included.

knowledge.title: Tana Outliner
knowledge.pricing_model: Free and paid plans, with plan-dependent AI credits.
knowledge.relevance: A structured note workspace using nodes, fields, Supertags and saved views.
knowledge.difference: A personal knowledge editor rather than Knowledge's source-linked claim CLI. This entry concerns Tana Outliner, which is distinct from Tana's meeting product; no import or integration is promised.

knowledge.title: Neo4j Aura and graph platform
knowledge.pricing_model: Free and paid cloud options; self-managed and enterprise offerings have separate terms.
knowledge.relevance: Graph storage, querying, analytics and tooling for building connected-data applications.
knowledge.difference: A graph platform on which a larger application can be built. Knowledge is a smaller local application with its own SQLite storage and evidence-oriented commands; it does not use Neo4j as a backend.

knowledge.title: Zep
knowledge.pricing_model: Credit-based self-service plans and negotiated enterprise plans.
knowledge.relevance: Managed context graphs and retrieval for enterprise information and agents, using Graphiti within its service.
knowledge.difference: It operates managed infrastructure and governance around graphs. Knowledge keeps a local application contract. No Zep account, integration, performance comparison or service endorsement is implied.
